items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Raymond Padua. Ray Padua. Ray Padua. And so the bass player was Bobby Haggard up there... I played with his brother too, Eddie.

ctx.x: Didn't you tell me that there was a lot of New Orleans musicians with the March of the Bobcat with Bob Crosby? Oh, I didn't know that.

You told me about the Blackhawk. Yeah, I said the Blackhawk. Yeah, Napoli Lamar, Eddie Miller, Fize, who else now? Hilton Lamar, Eddie Miller. Raymond Padua. Ray Padua. Ray Padua. And so the bass player was Bobby Haggard up there. And then Shields, always putting a job. I mean, I can't knock Harry, man. And Harry could always play clarinet, always. I played with his brother too, Eddie. You mean Eddie Shields? I've heard of him, I never met him. He played piano band, Eddie. I played with Larry in the disc. My…
